newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Ibex share index sheds 2.68 pct by close.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Ibex share index sheds 2.68 pct by close.

text.p: Spain's Ibex-35 blue chip share index fell 188.60 points by the close, or 2.68 percent, to 6,846.18 on Friday, hit by sharp losses on Wall Street and the expiry of July Ibex futures, dealers said.
Madrid's general stock index shed 2.43 percent to 603.29.
Traders said the move lower was long overdue after a record breaking run this year. But they added the market may get nervous in the face of such volatility.
Next week's performance is seen dependent on Wall Street, and major banks' results.
